steps.name: Spotted 'Kitty'
steps.text: Meow—

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (Sorry, kitties, I can't play with you today.)

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Here's where I live, mummy.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: By yourself, sweetheart?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: No, I have a roommate to keep me company.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Is that right...? I had no idea. I would've brought a gift for her.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: She's out on a mission right now and won't be back for a while. She says you can have her bed for these few days, if you want.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Well... I booked a hotel in a nearby city.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Right... I understand. A hotel would be more comfortable, after all.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: The room may be nice, but it would be too empty without my precious daughter. I'm not sure I'd be able to sleep.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: So you'll stay here?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: (Touches Mousse's nose) Yes, sweetheart.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I knew you were coming, so I spent an entire day cleaning up! Everything's sparkling!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Have you forgotten? You didn't even need to make your own bed at home.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Rhodes Island isn't like home. I have to do a lot on my own. It took some time to get used to, but I've learned a lot.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: At first, I didn't know how to put the comforter into its cover.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I kept struggling with it, but I just couldn't get it done.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Guess what happened when I finally managed to get it zipped up?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I almost zipped myself in with it! Hah!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: (Embarrassed smile) That's really something... haha.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Close your eyes, mummy!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Just close them for a little bit.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Hm... alright.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I guarantee you'll be shocked when you see my room.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I certainly am shocked, sweetheart.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Oh no, mummy... it wasn't like that this morning...
'Kitties' run rampant around the messy room.
The curtains have been reduced to barely-recognizable ribbons.
Less fortunate are the vases formerly on the table, with the broken shards on the ground the only sign that they were ever there in the first place.
A 'Kitty' stands on the table, preparing to leap over to the nearby wardrobe.
Mousse looks up to the wardrobe, a vase teeters by the edge, looking like it could fall at any second.

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: (Jumps on top of the wardrobe)

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: No! Not the vases!

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: Meow?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Bad kitty!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: How could you do this! You're all bad kitties!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: It's ok, sweetheart. They're mischievous creatures.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Sorry, mummy. This isn't what I had meant to show you. I really did clean up.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I know, sweetheart. Let's find a place to sit down and figure out how to put everything back in its proper place.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Let's see... is there anywhere we can sit?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Watch out! There's yarn on the floor!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Watch out for—Aiee!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I'm fine... it's just...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I'll call Medical!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: No, I'm not hurt. I just stepped on my dress when I tripped, and I think...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I think I put a hole in it.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: That was a long day... I'm sore all over.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Didn't you have the day off?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I was preparing for mummy's visit. I've been on edge for days.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Shouldn't you be happy to have family visiting? Why so nervous?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I've always been worried about disappointing mummy. My siblings are all outstanding, while I'm totally unremarkable.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I've no achievements to speak of, and I caught an illness that can't be spoken of...

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Don't be so down on yourself. Wasn't the Doctor just raving about your incredible progress a few days ago?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: It's... It's not enough. You don't know how incredible my siblings are.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Byron is already a lieutenant colonel, and Emily is consulting for several different banks straight out of school.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Violet is an authority on Originium Arts research. And my youngest brother, Carl...

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Violet? That Violet?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Yes, that Violet. She's my older sister.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Alright... I don't blame you for being nervous, then.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I got compared to them whenever I attended a gathering.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Mummy always defended me, but she's a proud woman, and she must be ashamed to have a daughter like me.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: That's what I hate about high society. The gossip never stops.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: That's why I wanted to show her how much I've grown.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Good afternoon, Mrs. Selis. My name is Bibeak, and I'm a friend of Mousse's.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Thank you for mending my skirt, Miss Bibeak.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I really appreciate it.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Er, I'm very glad I could help. Yes. Indeed.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: (Mousse's mother doesn't seem like the chatty type... wherever has Mousse gone? How long will we have to sit here staring at each other?)

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: (But what can we even talk about? Argh, I'll just pick a random topic...)

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath) Mrs. Selis, I...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Mummy, I made your favorite almond cake.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: (Finally!)

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: And I made a custard tart for you, Bibeak. It's your favorite, isn't it?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Thank you, Mousse! I've mended Mrs. Selis's skirt. Her blouse is fine.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Miss Bibeak did a splendid job. It's like the hole was never there.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: G-Great! Let me know whenever you'd care for a pastry. I, I'd love to make you anything.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: No need to go that far. You should sit down too. I'm sure Mrs. Selis can't wait to taste the cake.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Come, sweetheart, I haven't had your cake in ages.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: R-Right.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: How is it?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: It's delicious.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Yes. Just the perfect level of sweetness and moistness. It's so... agh!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I think I got something strange in my mouth.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: What are these? Hairs?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Oh no, it's kitty hair! Don't eat any more. I'll get you another piece.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Sorry, they must have gotten in when I forgot to lock the kitchen door.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: It's alright, sweetheart. I don't mind at all.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: But mummy...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: It's alright, really.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (But your eyes are turning red...)

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Mousse...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Ahem. I believe you're a designer, Miss Bibeak? Are you familiar with the latest trends?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: My usual tailor is rather conservative, and I would like to get some dresses that are more in fashion.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: What do young people like you enjoy in dresses?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Huh? Oh... knit details have been popular the past couple years.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Knit details... I remember when they were all the rage ten years ago. Or was it fifteen?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: You know what they say about fashion. It all comes back around.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (Twiddles fingers in silence)

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Here's your food, Mousse. I hope you ladies enjoy it.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (Looks at her cup of tea)

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Sweetheart?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Huh? Oh... wait, I didn't order this many dishes, did I?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: It's on the house. Always an occasion when an operator gets a family visit.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: They need me in the kitchen. Eat up.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Thank you, Hung.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Is the chef your friend too?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Hung knows how to make a lot of Yanese desserts. I pick his brain from time to time.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: It's a nice change of pace. You used to be alone all the time, with only your kitties to keep you company.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: And we're always so busy that we couldn't give you the care and attention you needed...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: You and daddy did everything you could to protect me!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I made a lot of friends here, but I've always missed you and daddy. I was so excited when I heard you were coming.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: My pay isn't very high, but I've managed to save some money.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Sweetheart... this is...?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I bought a tea set from Croissant. I hope you don't mind that it's not as nice as the ones you have at home...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: (hands over the chest) Oh... I would never denigrate a gift from you.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: What a beautiful tray! It's so pretty that I'm hesitant to even use it. Maybe I should just put it on display for everyone to see.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: As you like. I wanted to show you what I can do, but I keep making mistakes...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Are you still bothered by that? I told you, it was nothing to be upset about.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: But I saw... wait, a kitty in the cafeteria?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Where's the kitty?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: B-Behind you.

steps.name: Spotted 'Kitty'
steps.text: Mroaaaw—!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Whoah! Not on the table, kitty!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Oh no, my cup!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Bad kitty! You're all bad kitties!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: You're awful!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Why did you have to make a mess in front of mummy?!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I spent so much time cleaning up and saving money to buy her a present... bad kitties!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Don't cry, sweetheart...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: (Stands up)

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: What's the matter, Mousse? I heard you crying from the kitchen.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Just leave the pieces where they are, Mousse. I'll get a broom.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's alright, Mousse. I've got plenty of tea sets. Come over and pick one you like.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: What's all this then? Who's making my little Mousse cry? Give me a name, my hat and I'll show 'em what for.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: No... it's all my fault for not being good enough...

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Don't say that about yourself!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: (What a relief.)

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Come closer. Let me wipe your hair dry.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: You cut your hair short. I remember you used to like it long.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: It was troublesome out in the field, and when baking, so I cut it.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: It's fine. You look very pretty with short hair too.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Come, sweetheart, it's time for bed.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Mummy...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Are you sure you want to squeeze into my bed?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: You don't want me to?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: That's not it, I'm just worried you won't sleep well.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Violet said you hardly slept when you visited her, and you were staying in a five-star hotel.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Could you really sleep in a tiny bed with me?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Ah... it wasn't because of the bed that I had trouble sleeping.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Violet had an accident the day before, leaving a huge scar on her forehead. I was so worried that I couldn't sleep.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Luckily, it wasn't anything serious. She gave her lecture the following day as scheduled, and the crowd wouldn't stop clapping when she finished.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: You must have been proud.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Of course. Violet was always a bright girl. I hardly had to worry about her. Unlike Carl, who kept running around after breaking his elbow last month.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Did he get hurt in a match?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Yes, and he hid it until the final whistle. He didn't want to be taken out. Your father had words for him when he learned.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Did they win?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Of course... there isn't a better team in the age group.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: *yawn*...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (Retreats into the sheets)

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Mummy...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Are you disappointed in me?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Violet and Carl have done so much to make you proud, but I haven't... I'm not talented. I don't have any special skills.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I didn't get good grades in school. All I did was make you worry after I got sick. You had to take time off work to be with me.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I could never make you proud.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (Turns) Mummy?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Sweetheart...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: (Reaches for the other side of the bed)

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Sweetheart? Where did she go? The sun isn't up yet... there's nobody in the bathroom either.

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: Meow...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Kitty...?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Do you know where my sweetheart is, little one?

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: (Drops head and licks own butt)

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Don't ignore me, kitty.

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: (Keeps licking own butt)

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I know you must feel neglected because Mousse has been busy preparing for my visit. That's why you tried to get her attention.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Sorry. On her behalf.

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: Meow...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: (Strokes kitty's chin)

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Are you still upset?

steps.name: Striped 'Kitty'
steps.text: Meow.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Will you take me to her?
The kitty rubs itself against Mrs. Selis's feet, then goes over to the door and looks at her, as though telling her to follow.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: It's already six? I have to get that bread baked before breakfast...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: How could I oversleep?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: It must be because I was relaxed around mummy... the dough's ready. Now for the filling.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (Starts whipping cream)

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Aw... why does my hand have to itch right now?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I want to scratch it.... no, I'd better not, I won't be able to stop.
Let me help you, sweetheart.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Mummy?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: W-What are you doing here? Did I wake you up?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Are you always up so early making breakfast for the others?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: It's the only thing I'm good at. And I like to do it.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I never got much chance to do this at home, but it makes me happy to something I'm good at here.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Oh, sweetheart...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: How far along are you? I'll help you.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: It's alright, I can do it on my own.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Let's see. The dough's ready. I can help with the filling. You're using cream?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Er, yes. But mummy...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Shh, sweetheart. This is some mother and daughter time. It's been ages since we baked bread together.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Yes, mummy.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Please make the fillings then.
Mother and daughter go back and forth from the kitchen table to the oven.
There is hardly any talking. A slight gesture, a blink of the eye, is all the communication they need.
Fowlbeast eggs are broken and their contents dropped into bowls. Cream is whipped until filled with air. Syrup is brushed on the dough. Hot air seeps out of the pre-heated oven.
The sounds in the kitchen make a symphony of their own.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: We did it, mummy!

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Yes, sweetheart, we did.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Just in time for breakfast.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Yes, just in time for breakfast.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Maybe we can do a little more...?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Do what?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (Sprinkles a layer of icing on the bread)

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Now it's perfect.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis & Mousse
steps.text: (Gaze at each other)

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I'm proud of you, sweetheart. Very proud.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I've never told you that, have I?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Why? I know you're proud of Byron, of Emily, of Violet, and Carl. They're all outstanding.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: But I'm just Mousse... I'm not anything.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I've got two tails, I'm bad at maths, I don't know my grammar, I have Oripathy... and my hands get itchy when I have an Oripathy attack.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I don't care about any of that.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Then what do you care about?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Mummy only cares that you're happy and doing what you love.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I fought with your father a lot over whether to send you here.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I didn't want you going to this place on your own. It wouldn't be as comfortable as home, and we couldn't be there for you if anything happened.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Before I visited, I was thinking I would bring you back if you didn't like it here, even if I had to pummel your father into it.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: But you're happy here... you're not alone anymore. You have lots of friends who care for you.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: But I couldn't welcome you the way Violet could.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: That's rubbish, sweetheart. I've had a delightful time!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: But you had tears in your eyes when you found kitty fur in your cake yesterday...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: You've got it all wrong.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I was happy.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: You were?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I haven't enjoyed a pastry of yours in so long. Not since you got sick.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: I had an even more pleasant surprise when I walked into kitchen. You've started baking again, you're... you're still doing what you love here.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I never knew...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Mousse, my little sweetheart.

steps.name: Anxious Young Operator
steps.text: Mousse, I have a lesson this morning, so I need two to go... oh, good morning, ma'am.

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: Er, good morning.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Two to go, Zeiss? Here you are.

steps.name: Anxious Young Operator
steps.text: Thanks... hmm, I've never seen this kind of bread. What is it?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I just made it with the ingredients at hand. There isn't any...

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: 'Mother's Pride.'

steps.name: Mousse & Anxious Young Operator?
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mrs. Selis
steps.text: The name of the bread is 'Mother's Pride.'
